nbecb993020.headline: Iran war could result in UK petrol prices soaring as motorists issued warning
nbecb993020.summary: Iran sits on the edge of the Strait of Hormuz shipping lane, which carries around a fifth of the world's oil supply. Motorists in the UK have been warned petrol prices could soar.
nbecb993020.why: The Strait of Hormuz is one of the world's most important oil chokepoints, so disruption there quickly feeds into global crude and fuel prices.

n2ce31e9eda.headline: Uganda: Bou Reports 55 Percent Surge in Merchandise Exports to $13bn in 2025
n2ce31e9eda.summary: Uganda's merchandise exports rose to $13.43 billion in 2025 from $8.67 billion in 2024, according to new Bank of Uganda data. The increase is a sharp rise in one year.
n2ce31e9eda.why: Export earnings drive foreign exchange inflows and the Ugandan shilling, which matter for the country's external balance.

nd09357a374.headline: RJRGLEANER streamlining several subsidiaries
nd09357a374.summary: RJRGLEANER Communications Group is streamlining several subsidiaries under a scheme of arrangement. The Supreme Court of Judicature has sanctioned the scheme, which aims to improve corporate efficiency.
nd09357a374.why: RJRGLEANER is a Jamaican media and communications group, and restructurings can change its reporting structure and cost base.

nf000712081.headline: Kenya: Mudavadi Warns Middle East Conflict Could Disrupt Global Supply Chain
nf000712081.summary: Kenyan Prime Cabinet Secretary Musalia Mudavadi called for restraint and dialogue after renewed Middle East conflict. He warned of global security and economic repercussions.
nf000712081.why: Kenya is an East African economy that imports fuel and depends on global trade, so Middle East disruption feeds into its costs.

nd7d8bd9ea8.headline: War widens to include Tehran-backed militias as Israeli and US planes pound Iran
nd7d8bd9ea8.summary: Iran-backed militias fired missiles at Israel and Arab states as Israeli and US planes struck Iran. The US embassy compound in Kuwait has apparently been struck.
nd7d8bd9ea8.why: Kuwait is a major Gulf oil producer, so attacks in the region can affect crude supply and regional shipping security.

n1294334c94.headline: Grapes wither on the vine as record rain risks harvest
n1294334c94.summary: Flash flooding hit Australia's table grape hub after record rainfall at the peak of harvest season. The input says the harvest is threatened.
n1294334c94.why: Table grapes are a seasonal horticultural export, and harvest losses affect growers' revenue and supply.

n863217f5c4.headline: CCP Exposes Deep Flaws in Pakistan’s Auto Industry
n863217f5c4.summary: The Competition Commission of Pakistan issued a report on fair competition in Pakistan's automobile industry, identifying deep structural flaws.
n863217f5c4.why: Competition regulators review market structure in key industries, which can lead to policy changes affecting automakers and their pricing.

n44b16edc1c.headline: MWC26 Barcelona opens with call to complete 5G, rise to AI challenges, and strengthen digital safety
n44b16edc1c.summary: The telecom industry gathered in Barcelona for MWC26, with keynotes and summits focused on completing 5G rollout, meeting AI challenges and strengthening digital safety.
n44b16edc1c.why: The Mobile World Congress is the telecom industry's main annual event, and its agenda shapes spending on networks, 5G and AI services.

n5f9d27ccbe.headline: Tuya Inc. Bottom Line Advances In Q4
n5f9d27ccbe.summary: Tuya Inc. reported a higher profit for its fourth quarter compared with a year earlier. Earnings came in at $19.31 million, or $0.03 per share.
n5f9d27ccbe.why: Tuya is a cloud platform provider for smart devices, and its quarterly results indicate demand for its IoT software services.

nadea1ef0bf.headline: Fears UK energy prices will rise as cost of oil spikes following Iran attacks
nadea1ef0bf.summary: Concerns are growing that UK energy prices will rise as oil costs spike following Iran attacks. The situation may echo the price hike seen after Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
nadea1ef0bf.why: UK household energy bills are set by regulated price caps that respond to wholesale gas and oil costs, affecting inflation and consumer spending.

ne85641f94e.headline: What to know about the latest US-Israeli attacks on Iran
ne85641f94e.summary: Fallout from the latest US-Israeli attacks on Iran has been felt around the globe, according to a news explainer on the fighting.
ne85641f94e.why: Military conflict involving major oil producers affects energy prices, risk assets and global investor sentiment.

n3b50f823fd.headline: Life360, Inc. Bottom Line Rises In Q4
n3b50f823fd.summary: Life360 reported a higher fourth-quarter profit compared with a year earlier, with earnings totalling $129.65 million, or $1.51 per share.
n3b50f823fd.why: Life360 is a family location-sharing app company listed in the US and on the Australian Securities Exchange, so its results are watched by both investor bases.

nb3b6960a7a.headline: Militias join widened war as Israel and US pound Iran
nb3b6960a7a.summary: Israel expanded its campaign to attacks on Iran-backed Hezbollah militants in Lebanon, while a senior Iranian official said Iran will not negotiate with the United States.
nb3b6960a7a.why: Expansion of the conflict to Lebanon raises regional escalation risk, affecting oil, shipping and risk assets across the Middle East.

n5df30a4dd6.headline: Oil prices surge, Asian stocks fall over Iran conflict
n5df30a4dd6.summary: Oil prices soared and Asian stocks fell on Monday after US and Israeli strikes on Iran, with the Strait of Hormuz effectively shut.
n5df30a4dd6.why: Brent crude is the global oil benchmark, and sharp oil moves affect inflation, energy costs and Asian equity markets, which import much of their energy.
n5df30a4dd6.why_moved: Oil prices rose and Asian stocks fell after US and Israeli strikes on Iran effectively shut the Strait of Hormuz, a major oil shipping route.

necbd5d0177.headline: Osaki Electric signs EMS development pact with Kyocera, Taiwan Plastics
necbd5d0177.summary: Osaki Electric has signed an agreement to jointly develop an AI-based energy management system integrating solar generation and LFP battery storage. It aims to sign a final contract by December 2026.
necbd5d0177.why: Energy management systems that combine solar and battery storage are a growing area of industrial and grid energy investment.

n49337f6d4b.headline: New locations sought for Aussie beef due to China levy
n49337f6d4b.summary: Import quotas introduced by China are expected to reorder the global beef trade and push Australian exporters to find new locations.
n49337f6d4b.why: China is one of the largest importers of beef, so changes to its import rules shift export flows for major beef producers like Australia.

n7b58b54fd5.headline: IT body Nasscom advises against travel to the Middle East
n7b58b54fd5.summary: India's IT body Nasscom advised against travel to the Middle East, warning the conflict could slow tech spending and freeze expansion plans in the region for an already stressed sector.
n7b58b54fd5.why: Nasscom represents India's IT services industry, whose large exporters depend on global clients and cross-border delivery.

n570bdb921d.headline: India and Canada agree to boost economic partnership in a move to reset ties
n570bdb921d.summary: India and Canada agreed to strengthen their economic partnership, aiming to reset ties after two years of strained relations.
n570bdb921d.why: Bilateral trade and investment agreements shape market access and cross-border deals for companies in both countries.

ne0f98728f7.headline: Middle East crisis could affect petrol, heating and electricity bills in Ireland
ne0f98728f7.summary: Up to 20,000 Irish people are stranded in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Doha as airports remain closed. The Middle East crisis could affect petrol, heating and electricity bills in Ireland.
ne0f98728f7.why: Ireland imports most of its oil and gas, so supply disruptions in the Gulf pass quickly into domestic energy prices. Energy costs feed directly into household budgets and inflation.

n1632f653d4.headline: 6 U.S. soldiers have been killed as the war with Iran further engulfs the region
n1632f653d4.summary: The war over Iran spread further across the Middle East on Monday as strikes intensified and Iran-backed groups stepped up attacks. A sixth U.S. service member was killed in action.
n1632f653d4.why: Conflict involving Iran affects oil and gas supply through the Gulf, where a large share of global energy flows. Escalation tends to raise energy prices and risk premiums across markets.

nd51514eb59.headline: Sensex crashes 2,743 points at open, Nifty slips to 24,659; Rs 7.8 lakh crore wealth eroded - BusinessToday
nd51514eb59.summary: The BSE Sensex fell as much as 2,743.46 points to 78,543.73 at the open, while the NSE Nifty dropped 519.4 points to 24,659.25. About Rs 7.8 lakh crore in investor wealth was eroded.
nd51514eb59.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmarks of Indian equities, tracking the largest listed companies on the BSE and NSE.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: The benchmark index itself fell sharply at the open.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nd51514eb59.why_moved: The sharp opening fall came amid the Middle East conflict and oil supply concerns, according to the broader market backdrop in the input.

n7edc723f56.headline: Oil breakout: Price jumps 13%, surpasses $80 on Middle East war-linked supply fears
n7edc723f56.summary: Crude prices soared in Asia as a prolonged Strait of Hormuz disruption could remove 8-10m bpd from supply. Shipping companies have begun suspending fleet movements.
n7edc723f56.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries roughly a fifth of global crude oil supply, so disruptions there quickly feed into global energy prices, inflation expectations and growth forecasts.
n7edc723f56.why_moved: Reports of a prolonged Strait of Hormuz disruption that could remove 8-10m bpd of supply drove the sharp price jump.

nd1613efa68.headline: Gaza fuel running short after Israel closes borders
nd1613efa68.summary: Border closures are raising fears of a return to famine that gripped parts of Gaza last year, after Israel blocked aid for 11 weeks.
nd1613efa68.why: Fuel shortages disrupt humanitarian logistics and local economic activity, and they feed into regional political risk for investors.

nb3389b4d93.headline: Oil prices surge, but no panic yet, as Iran war continues
nb3389b4d93.summary: Global oil prices are in the high $70s a barrel as traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has come to a halt. Some analysts warn prices could top $100 if the stoppage is prolonged.
nb3389b4d93.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for seaborne oil shipments from the Gulf. Disruptions there move global crude prices quickly.
nb3389b4d93.why_moved: Traffic halting through the Strait of Hormuz removes a major share of oil supply, pushing prices higher.

nb6c4e2bf34.headline: 'Panic selling': PSX plunges over 15,000 points amid geopolitical tensions
nb6c4e2bf34.summary: The KSE-100 index closed at 151,972.99, down 16,089.17 points or 9.57%, after hitting a low of 151,747.96. Geo News described the session as panic selling amid geopolitical tensions.
nb6c4e2bf34.why: The KSE-100 is the benchmark index of the Pakistan Stock Exchange, tracking the largest listed companies in Pakistan.
nb6c4e2bf34.why_moved: Sharp selling followed geopolitical tensions, as investors reacted to the Middle East conflict and its risks.

nb17be4af31.headline: Canadian Stocks Recover From Early Weakness To Reach New Record Highs
nb17be4af31.summary: The S&P/TSX Composite Index climbed off its early lows on Monday and ended the day in positive territory, reaching new record highs. The index gained 201 points at the close.
nb17be4af31.why: The S&P/TSX Composite is Canada's main equity benchmark, covering the largest companies listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

impacts.name: S&P/TSX Composite Index
impacts.why: The benchmark index rebounded from early weakness to finish higher and at a record.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

nec7fd47042.headline: Travel stocks fall after thousands of flights grounded following Iran strikes
nec7fd47042.summary: Airline and travel stocks slipped on Monday after airspace closures across the Middle East forced cancellations of thousands of flights, including to Dubai and Doha. The disruption follows the US-Israel conflict with Iran.
nec7fd47042.why: Airlines and travel companies depend on open airspace and hub airports, so regional closures hit their revenue and costs.
nec7fd47042.why_moved: Airspace closures across the Middle East forced thousands of flight cancellations, hurting airline and travel share prices.

na23b51846c.headline: Banyan Group Delivers Strong FY25 Results, Revenue up 25% on Record Residences Driver
na23b51846c.summary: Banyan Tree Holdings reported FY25 revenue up 25% for the year ended 31 December 2025, driven by record residences sales. The results were announced via press release.
na23b51846c.why: Banyan Tree is a Singapore-based luxury hospitality and residences group, and its results reflect demand for premium resorts and property.

nd3e4f7bef8.headline: Thailand rolls out energy crisis plan: export curb, alternative supplies
nd3e4f7bef8.summary: Thailand is activating measures to stabilise fuel supply and prices, including an export curb, after Iran shut the Strait of Hormuz, and says it has 61 days of fuel.
nd3e4f7bef8.why: Thailand imports much of its energy, so supply disruptions through key shipping routes directly affect its fuel security.

n0e27fd0c36.headline: 6 U.S. soldiers have been killed as the war with Iran further engulfs the region
n0e27fd0c36.summary: The war over Iran engulfed more of the Middle East on Monday as strikes intensified and Iran-backed groups stepped up attacks. A sixth US service member was killed in action.
n0e27fd0c36.why: A widening regional war raises risks to oil shipping, energy supply and global financial markets.

n3835193856.headline: Oil prices soar and stock prices fall as US-Israel war with Iran rattles markets
n3835193856.summary: Oil prices rose and stock prices fell as the US-Israel war with Iran spread, with the conflict expected to disrupt oil supplies from Iran and elsewhere in the Middle East.
n3835193856.why: Brent and WTI crude are global benchmarks, and Middle East supply disruptions feed directly into fuel costs, inflation and equity valuations.
n3835193856.why_moved: The war is expected to disrupt oil supplies from Iran and elsewhere in the Middle East, pushing oil prices higher while stocks fell.

n5a0b96b39f.headline: US Oil Prices Surge After Iran Attack
n5a0b96b39f.summary: US oil prices surged on Monday amid the ongoing Operation Epic Fury in Iran.
n5a0b96b39f.why: WTI crude is the main US oil benchmark, and military action in the Middle East directly affects supply expectations and fuel prices.
n5a0b96b39f.why_moved: Oil prices rose during the ongoing military operation in Iran, which raised concerns about Middle East supply.

n4e30e859e9.headline: Insurers cancel war risk cover amid Iran conflict
n4e30e859e9.summary: Insurers are cancelling war risk coverage for vessels in the Gulf as the widening Iran conflict disrupts shipping, with at least four tankers damaged and two seafarers killed.
n4e30e859e9.why: War risk insurance is required for ships entering conflict zones, and its withdrawal can halt or raise the cost of Gulf oil and cargo shipments.

nf3cd86d848.headline: US Oil Prices Surge After Iran Attack
nf3cd86d848.summary: US oil prices surged on Monday amid the ongoing military operation in Iran. The report links the move to the conflict's escalation.
nf3cd86d848.why: West Texas Intermediate is the main US crude benchmark, and its price influences fuel costs, inflation and energy company earnings. Prices react sharply to Middle East supply risks.
nf3cd86d848.why_moved: The report ties the surge to the ongoing military operation in Iran, which raises fears of supply disruption in the Middle East.

ndf8dc906d6.headline: BYD Sales Collapse. What About Tesla?
ndf8dc906d6.summary: According to the FT, BYD reported February sales down 41% year on year to 190,190. The decline was driven by a 65% drop in one segment.
ndf8dc906d6.why: BYD is China's largest electric vehicle maker and a leading global EV seller. Its sales trends are a key indicator of demand in the competitive EV market.

impacts.name: BYD
impacts.why: A 41% year-on-year drop in monthly sales signals weaker demand for the company's vehicles.

ne53a9d4f73.headline: Hormuz disruption feared to hurt Korean economy
ne53a9d4f73.summary: Concerns are mounting that South Korea's economy could take a hit from disruptions to oil and gas shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.
ne53a9d4f73.why: South Korea imports most of its crude oil and much of its LNG, so disruptions to Gulf shipments quickly affect its energy costs and growth outlook.

n4996bcfe50.headline: US stocks erase sharp losses, while oil prices leap on worries about Iran war
n4996bcfe50.summary: Oil prices leaped Monday on worries the war with Iran could clog global crude flows and worsen inflation. U.S. stocks swung from sharp losses to a tiny gain.
n4996bcfe50.why: The S&P 500 tracks large US companies, and oil prices feed into inflation expectations and interest rates that shape equity valuations.
n4996bcfe50.why_moved: Fears that the Iran war could disrupt global crude supply and worsen inflation drove oil prices up while equities oscillated between losses and a tiny gain.

n7cd9731cc6.headline: Energy prices surge as tanker disruptions, facility shutdowns, rattle global supply
n7cd9731cc6.summary: Oil prices rose sharply on Monday as disruptions to tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz raised uncertainty over how US and Israeli attacks on Iran would affect supply.
n7cd9731cc6.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for seaborne crude and refined products, so disruptions there move global oil prices quickly.
n7cd9731cc6.why_moved: Disruption to tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz raised uncertainty about crude supply as US and Israeli attacks on Iran continued.

n36508dcc74.headline: US-Israeli war on Iran expands and shuts down Gulf oil and gas production
n36508dcc74.summary: The US-Israeli war on Iran has expanded and shut down Gulf oil and gas production. Hezbollah fire on Israel has also sparked a Lebanon bombing campaign.
n36508dcc74.why: The Gulf region supplies a large share of the world's oil and LNG, so production shutdowns there move global energy prices.
n36508dcc74.why_moved: Expanding conflict has shut Gulf oil and gas production, removing supply from global markets.

n1c69e68a2f.headline: UK natural gas price soars as Iran strikes spark WW3 fears - what it means
n1c69e68a2f.summary: UK gas future prices have leapt more than 40% to £1.15 per therm. The rise follows Iran strikes that have raised fears of wider conflict.
n1c69e68a2f.why: UK wholesale gas prices feed into household energy bills and industrial costs across Britain and Europe.
n1c69e68a2f.why_moved: Gas futures rose more than 40% after Iran strikes raised supply-disruption fears in global energy markets.

neda17058fc.headline: Qatar state‑run QatarEnergy halts LNG production after Iran drone attacks, sends European gas prices soaring
neda17058fc.summary: QatarEnergy, Qatar's state-owned energy giant, suspended liquefied natural gas production on Monday after Iranian drone attacks. European gas prices soared.
neda17058fc.why: QatarEnergy is one of the world's largest LNG producers, so its output affects global gas supply and European energy prices.
neda17058fc.why_moved: Suspension of Qatari LNG output after drone attacks cut a major source of global gas supply, sending European prices soaring.
